# Re-elects each region's anchor state: the highest-priority held state
# (priority = coastal contact desc, state id asc) gets the region's anchor
# flag, so exactly ONE map icon shows per sea region. 'Held' is defined by
# JAP_te_state_held_trigger (scripted_triggers/JAP_rework_scripted_triggers.txt).
# Called daily (on_daily_JAP) and after seeding.

		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { 658 = { JAP_te_state_held_trigger = yes } }
		658 = {
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor
			set_state_flag = JAP_te_anchor_372
		}
	}
}
